args.goal: Prepare one clean standalone publication candidate for the existing independently source-reviewed supplier bid-effort worksheet. First read relevant lessons, products/reviews/supplier-worksheet/final-verdict.json and products/services/software-renewals/supplier-access/delivery/ completely; check equivalent work before creating anything. Reuse the existing worksheet and saved original sources without new research or functionality. Create products/sites/supplier-bid-effort/ containing only index.html and worksheet-en-fr.md. Correct the review's concrete nits: make official HTML citations clickable and attach exact HSE award-notice provenance from the saved original release; do not guess a notice URL. Preserve complete EN/FR limitations, conflicting framework dates, historical call-off continuity, unknown current admission, approval-dependent key subcontracting, HSE route discrepancy, autonomous-AI disclosure and the distinction between planning suggestions and official requirements. Keep the existing documented software-award-brief intake route and identifier only if its documentation supports use here; otherwise provide the worksheet without promising monitored intake. No price, checkout or delivery promises. This is a standalone delivery of existing reviewed work, not another product or a workaround for rejected software-award-brief publication. Do not copy rejected CSV files or modify any existing site. Verify exact inventory, citations, downloaded Markdown equality and supported factual scope. Save/read scoped results, obtain PUBLISH_SITE dry_run and request independent AUDITOR review of its exact digest in another eligible provider turn; do not deploy. Save an exposure proposal defining an actual relevant classified request as the outcome and UNKNOWN when coverage is missing; publication alone is not success. No new scans, accounts, outreach, spending or notification. Complete only with actual valid ownership, evidence and a lesson. Preserve all existing observation, expiry and retirement duties; host-enforced writer/reviewer/publisher independence remains mandatory.

description: Independent review supports the supplier worksheet as a planning aid, but no clean publication candidate exists. Prepare a standalone delivery page from that reviewed work, correcting its citation nits and excluding the rejected CSV revision. Five unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown; verified available funds and revenue remain zero. This preparation requires fresh exact-digest review before deployment.
